resources.string: Set manual prices for each provider and model. Rates use the currency you choose; different currencies are shown separately.
Prices are saved when a model attempt starts. Changing or removing a price affects future attempts only.
No matching models. Add a model in provider settings first.
Price not set · costs remain unknown
Saved cache rates · read %1$s / write %2$s per million tokens
Use a decimal point and up to 8 decimal places, between 0 and 1,000,000. Input and output are required. Leave cache prices blank if unknown; enter 0 for free.
Check the currency code and decimal rates. Negative numbers, exponent notation and thousands separators are not accepted.
Could not save prices. Your edits are kept; try again.
Future attempts will have unknown costs. Existing estimates and their price snapshots are kept.
Cost unknown · price or reported usage is missing
Estimates include recorded root, subagent and compaction requests at manual prices. Missing usage, ambiguous retries and non-token service fees prevent a full task bill.
